login.title: Sign in
login.greeting: Welcome back. Sign in to continue with your analyses.
login.noAccount: No account yet? Ask your administrator for access.

passwordChange.title: Change your password
passwordChange.reason: This account still uses its initial password. Choose a new one to continue.
passwordChange.hint: At least 12 characters. A long phrase beats a strange symbol.

home.subtitle: Your analyses in progress will show up here.
home.nextStepBody: Register a system and upload its code to get the first report.

errors.internal: Something failed on our side. Try again in a moment.
errors.validation: Check the data: something is missing or has an unexpected format.
errors.network: We could not reach the server. Check your connection.

auth.accountLocked: Too many failed attempts. Wait a few minutes before retrying.
auth.accountDisabled: This account is disabled. Talk to your administrator.
auth.invalidToken: Your session is not valid. Sign in again.
auth.sessionRevoked: We closed your session for safety. Sign in again.
auth.passwordChangeRequired: You must change your password before continuing.
auth.weakPassword: That password is too short. Use at least 12 characters.
auth.forbidden: Your role is not allowed to do this.
auth.invalidUsername: The username must be initial + lastname, lowercase, with no dots.

ingest.failed: The submitted code could not be processed.
ingest.zipSlip: The ZIP file contains forbidden paths.
ingest.zipTooLarge: The ZIP file exceeds the maximum allowed size.
ingest.tooManyEntries: The ZIP file has too many entries.
ingest.zipBomb: The ZIP file has a suspicious compression ratio.
ingest.invalidArchive: The file is not a valid ZIP.
ingest.forbiddenHost: The repository address points to a forbidden network.
ingest.invalidUrl: The repository address is not valid (HTTPS only).
ingest.repoUnreachable: The repository could not be reached.

analysis.notReady: The analysis has not finished yet.
analysis.sbomInvalid: The generated component inventory is not valid.
analysis.normalization: A tool's output could not be interpreted.
analysis.noToolRan: No analysis tool could run. Check the installation.

report.renderFailed: The report could not be generated.
report.versionNotFound: That report version does not exist.
report.versionNotCurrent: Only the current version can be signed. Reload the page.
report.unknownSection: That report section cannot be edited.
report.sectionTooLong: The section text is too long.

workflow.failed: The workflow action could not be completed.
workflow.justificationRequired: Write a reason of at least 10 characters: it goes to the audit log.
workflow.stageFinal: The report is the last stage: there is nowhere to advance.
workflow.stageLocked: That stage is already closed: its content cannot change.
workflow.testPlanNotFound: There is no test plan yet.
workflow.testPlanEmpty: Include at least one function in the plan.
workflow.testPlanFunctionUnknown: One of the chosen functions is not in the analysis metrics. Reload the page.

gate.closed: The current stage does not meet its condition to close yet.
gate.analysisNotDone: The analysis has not finished yet.
gate.triagePending: Findings are still pending review: each one needs a verdict.
gate.testPlanMissing: The test plan is missing: at least one function, the coverage strictness and your rationale.
gate.notBuilt: This stage cannot be closed yet in this version of the platform.

workflow.stageNotReached: That stage has not started yet: the previous ones close first.

ast.failed: That function's code could not be analyzed.
ast.unsupportedLanguage: That file is not in a language the platform analyzes (JS/TS and Python in this version).
ast.sourceTooLarge: The file is too large to draw.
ast.functionNotFound: We could not find that function in the code.
ast.parseFailed: The function has syntax errors; fix them in the code before designing.
ast.tooDeep: The function is nested beyond the limit; simplify it before designing.
ast.functionNotInPlan: That function is not in the test plan.

analysis.failedBody: The analysis could not finish. Code:

projects.title: Projects
projects.subtitle: Every system the factory audits, with its latest analysis.
projects.nextStepBody: Register the system you are going to analyze: name, technology and owner.
projects.nextStepBodyDeveloper: An analyst registers the systems. Here you will see the projects where you have to write tests.

form.intro: These details go straight into the report's "System details" table.
form.name: Project name
form.hint: You will upload the code next.

nextStep.codeBody: Upload a ZIP or paste the repository's HTTPS address. The analysis runs on its own and tells you when it is done.
nextStep.triageBody: Confirm or discard every finding with a written reason. When you finish, the test plan unlocks.
nextStep.planBody: The developer picks which functions to test and how strictly. The findings review is closed.
nextStep.laterBody: Follow the process from the Workflow tab. Every stage closes with a written reason.

ingest.intro: The code is analyzed in an isolated environment with no internet access. Nothing from the system is executed.
ingest.privacy: Everything stays on this server: no tool queries external services.

explain.title: What are we going to review?
explain.security: patterns that allow injections, XSS, exposed secrets.
explain.deps: libraries with known vulnerabilities, according to the local database.
explain.secrets: passwords, keys and tokens left in the code or its history.
explain.health: complexity per function, lines per language, commented-out code.

analyses.title: Analyses
analyses.empty: No version has been analyzed yet.

findings.title: Findings and review
findings.confirm: It's real — include in the report
findings.justificationLabel: Why? Your reason goes to the audit log
findings.justificationPlaceholder: E.g.: the file is a sample that is never deployed; the secret was already rotated.
findings.justificationHint: At least {{min}} characters. Required to confirm and to discard.

nextStep.pendingBody: When you finish, the next step unlocks: planning the tests.
nextStep.doneBody: Every finding has a verdict. Move on to the test plan, or edit and sign the report.
nextStep.advance: Move on to the test plan

report.title: Report
report.subtitle: Version {{number}} · institutional template
report.editedHint: This section has its own text; the rest comes from the template.
report.versionLine: Version {{number}} · edited by {{user}} · full history in the audit log.
report.versionLineBaseline: Version 1 · generated automatically. Saving a change creates version 2.

nextStep.triageBody: The report can already be read and exported, but sign it once the review is complete.
nextStep.readyTitle: Report ready to edit and sign
nextStep.readyBody: Review each section, fix what is needed and sign the final version. Signing locks it.
nextStep.signedBody: This version cannot change. Editing a section opens the next version.

edit.textHint: Plain text. Separate paragraphs with a blank line.
edit.changeLabel: What did you change? It goes to the version control table
edit.changePlaceholder: E.g.: the analysis scope was adjusted as agreed.

sign.label: Sign this version — why do you approve it?
sign.placeholder: E.g.: reviewed in full with the development team.
sign.hint: Signing locks the version. Later changes open a new one.
sign.locked: The current version is signed and locked.

versions.title: Version control
versions.none: No saved versions yet: the report exports as generated.

advance.reasonLabel: Why are you closing this stage? It goes to the audit log
advance.reasonPlaceholder: E.g.: every finding has a verdict and the team reviewed the discarded ones.

plan.title: What are we going to test?
plan.subtitle: Functions ranked by risk: how complex each one is and whether it has security findings. Pick the ones that enter the plan.
plan.noFunctions: The analysis measured no functions (Lizard did not run or the code has no recognizable functions).

reason.complexWithFindings: Very complex ({{ccn}} possible paths) and with {{count}} security finding(s) in its file — an urgent candidate.
reason.complex: Very complex ({{ccn}} possible paths), no findings.
reason.mediumWithFindings: Medium complexity ({{ccn}} paths) and {{count}} security finding(s) in its file.
reason.simpleWithFindings: Simple ({{ccn}} paths), but with {{count}} security finding(s) in its file.
reason.simple: Simple ({{ccn}} paths), no findings. It can wait.

criterion.title: How strict will the coverage be?
criterion.statementsHint: With "Statements" every line runs at least once. It is the minimum.
criterion.decisionsHint: With "Decisions" every branch of the code is tested true and false. It is the plan's standard.
criterion.pathsHint: With "Paths" every independent path is walked. The strictest; use it on critical functions.

plan.rationaleLabel: Why this plan? In your own words
plan.rationalePlaceholder: E.g.: we start with validation because it concentrates the findings and every form uses it.
plan.rationaleHint: At least {{min}} characters. Your rationale goes into the report.
plan.rationaleInReport: Your rationale goes into the report.
plan.saveAndDesign: Save plan and design the cases →

nextStep.notYetBody: The findings review closes first. You can look at the ranking meanwhile.
nextStep.emptyTitle: Pick the functions that enter the plan
nextStep.developerBody: Include the functions, choose the strictness and explain why. Saving and moving on opens the case design.
nextStep.readerBody: The developer builds the plan. Here you can see what they chose and why.
nextStep.lockedBody: The plan stage is closed: the case design works on this plan and it cannot change.

plan.incomplete: Include at least one function and write your rationale ({{min}} characters or more).

design.title: Case design
design.subtitle: Every function of the plan, drawn from its code. Design your cases looking at the diagram and the brief.

diagram.loading: Drawing the diagram from the code…
diagram.legend: Diamonds: decisions and loops · red border: error or exception · dashed arrow: back to the loop.

mermaid.title: Diagram (Mermaid) · editable
mermaid.editedBy: Text edited by {{user}}. The drawing above is still the code's.
mermaid.note: Arrange the diagram as you like; the brief is computed from the code, not from the diagram.

cases.title: Your cases, in your words
cases.intro: Describe what you will test and what you expect to happen. The code comes later.
cases.pending: The brief and the case editor arrive in the platform's next delivery. Meanwhile, review the diagrams.

nextStep.notYetBody: The test plan closes first. You can look at the diagrams meanwhile.
nextStep.diagramsBody: Review each function's diagram. When the brief arrives, you will write your cases right here.
